import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(df: pd.DataFrame):
    numeric_df = df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).copy()

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()

    result = pd.DataFrame(columns=["principal component 1", "principal component 2"], index=df.index)

    if numeric_df.shape[1] == 0 or numeric_df.shape[0] == 0:
        ax.set_xlabel("principal component")
        ax.set_ylabel("principal component 2")
        return result, ax

    numeric_df = numeric_df.fillna(numeric_df.mean(axis=0))
    numeric_df = numeric_df.fillna(0)

    n_samples, n_features = numeric_df.shape
    n_components = min(2, n_samples, n_features)

    if n_components == 0:
        ax.set_xlabel("principal component")
        ax.set_ylabel("principal component 2")
        return result, ax

    pca = PCA(n_components=n_components)
    transformed = pca.fit_transform(numeric_df)

    if n_components == 1:
        transformed = np.hstack([transformed, np.zeros((transformed.shape[0], 1))])

    result = pd.DataFrame(
        transformed[:, :2],
        columns=["principal component 1", "principal component 2"],
        index=df.index,
    )

    sns.scatterplot(
        data=result,
        x="principal component 1",
        y="principal component 2",
        ax=ax,
    )

    ax.set_xlabel("principal component")
    ax.set_ylabel("principal component 2")

    return result, ax
